must_have: Strong Python or Go in production
SQL databases and query performance tuning (PostgreSQL)
responsibilities: Design and implement scalable backend services
Own event-driven pipelines and improve reliability
Reduce latency and operational burden via observability and SLOs
Mentor engineers and lead design reviews
Collaborate with SRE on incident response and capacity planning

summary: Senior backend engineer with 7+ years building production APIs and event-driven pipelines in Python and Go. Led Kafka-based ingestion and FastAPI microservices on AWS, cutting p95 latency by 57% and scaling event throughput 4x. Strong PostgreSQL tuning, observability (OpenTelemetry, SLOs), and mentoring; fintech-adjacent API experience at a payments company.

bullets.text: Designed and rolled out a Kafka-based ingestion service replacing a cron poller, scaling event throughput from 2M to 8M events/day while coordinating schema contracts with data science.
Led migration of a monolithic REST module to a FastAPI microservice on AWS (ALB, ECS), reducing p95 API latency from 420ms to 180ms over six months and training two mid-level engineers.
Introduced OpenTelemetry distributed tracing and SLO dashboards with SRE partners, contributing to on-call incidents dropping from 12/month to 4/month year over year.
Optimized hot PostgreSQL workloads via indexing and connection pooling, cutting batch job runtime by 45% and publishing a team query review checklist.
Built and maintained Go microservices for merchant onboarding and settlement webhooks, improving delivery success from 94% to 99.2% with idempotent retry logic and a dead-letter queue.
Participated in on-call rotation and authored a production postmortem after a Redis failover incident; partnered with security on OAuth2 client-credentials integrations for partners.
